simple.summary: דִּקְלָה (Diqlâh) means Diklah , a region of Arabia First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 21.

definitions.full: H1853. Diqlah דִּקְלָה proper name, masculine (location) a son of Joktan , i.e. an Arabian territory or people Gen 10:27 = 1Chr 1:21 ; unknown, compare Di Gen 10:27 .
